newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei closes at highest since mid-December.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei closes at highest since mid-December.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market returned from a long holiday weekend in a bullish mood, with the benchmark index powering above the closely watched 20,000 point barrier for the first time since mid-December.
Brokers said a buying binge by foreign investors combined with pension fund purchases to fuel a hefty gain of over three percent.
The 225-share Nikkei average jumped 666.17 points or 3.41 percent to finish at 20,180.92, the highest closing level since 20,413.46 set on December 17.
The rise was the second largest in the calendar year, following a rise of about 815 points recorded on January 13.
